steps.text: 1. The Tourist opens the itinerary and taps "Follow itinerary" in the bottom bar. A2.
2. No location permission yet → the system shows the "Automatic listening by location" dialog (first time only).
4. The system opens the player (/itinerary/:id/go?mode=gps), loads the itinerary, asks for location permission and shows the map with the position, the places in order and the trigger zones. E1, E2.

exceptions.text: E1. The browser blocks location permission or the device does not support it → "Location is not available", suggesting "Preview each place".
E2. Weak GPS → weak signal warning.

steps.text: 6. On entering a place's zone, the system plays the place's audio automatically (recorded audio or the device's voice) with text and photos.
7. The Tourist uses the controls: play / pause, previous / next place.
8. At the last place, the system shows the completion dialog.

exceptions.text: E3. The itinerary does not exist (404), belongs to someone else (403) or the user is not signed in → error / go to Sign in.
E4. The share link has been revoked → reports that the link is no longer valid.
E5. No network → open the downloaded itinerary package in Account → Downloaded tours (UC#03).

steps: A2.1. The recipient opens /shared/:token (no sign-in needed) and chooses "Follow itinerary" or "Preview".
A2.2. The system loads the shared itinerary and uses the same player, read-only. E4.
A1.1. The Tourist chooses "Preview" (or "Preview each place", or taps a place).
A1.2. The system opens the player with ?mode=remote and plays the selected place, no GPS needed.
